mapper.select: SELECT id, pet_id AS petId, before_diagnosis_id AS beforeDiagnosisId, before_image_url AS beforeImageUrl, before_date AS beforeDate, after_image_url AS afterImageUrl, after_date AS afterDate, progress_status AS progressStatus, gemini_analysis AS geminiAnalysis, created_at AS createdAt FROM timeline_compares WHERE pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO timeline_compares (pet_id, before_diagnosis_id, before_image_url, before_date, after_image_url, after_date, progress_status, gemini_analysis) VALUES (#{petId}, #{beforeDiagnosisId}, #{beforeImageUrl}, #{beforeDate}, #{afterImageUrl}, #{afterDate}, #{progressStatus}, #{geminiAnalysis})
